title: Quantization Does Not Undo Abliteration: A Measurement Study of Refusal in Compressed Language Models (artifact)
description: Artifact for the ARTMAN 2026 (ACSAC workshop) paper. Evaluation prompts, judge verdicts for all 46,600 generations (response text replaced by SHA-256), human annotation labels, checkpoint-differencing and rank-sweep measurements, and the code that produces every table and figure in the paper. Raw model responses are distributed as a separate restricted file on this record.
